episodes.title: If Only I Had Thorns Like a Thistle...
episodes.summary: Ryuko Matoi, searching for her father's killer, transfers to Honnōji Academy - a school ruled by powerful uniforms - after a confrontation leads her to a living sailor uniform with extraordinary powers.

episodes.title: So Sexy, I`m Going to Faint
episodes.summary: Weakened from her first battle, Ryuko collapses and is rescued. When she returns to Honnōji Academy, she faces off against the Girls' Tennis Club captain to repay her debt.

episodes.title: Junketsu
episodes.summary: Ryuko seeks answers from her teacher about the source of her uniform's power. Meanwhile, elite student Satsuki Kiryuin returns to claim her own formidable outfit.

episodes.title: Dawn of a Miserable Morning
episodes.summary: Sirens signal "No-Late Day" at Honnōji Academy. With her uniform in the wash, Ryuko must brave traps by the Discipline Committee to reach class on time.

episodes.title: Hikigane (Trigger)
episodes.summary: A mysterious fighter arrives at the academy, showcasing incredible strength and soon turns his sights toward Ryuko.

episodes.title: Don't Toy Me on a Whim
episodes.summary: Overwhelmed by recent revelations, Ryuko questions her teacher yet again, while an elite student challenges her to a duel.

episodes.title: A Loser I Can`t Hate
episodes.summary: Ryuko battles club after club as Mako points out the reward - better uniforms and status - prompting Ryuko to strategize her next steps.

episodes.title: I`ll Wipe My Own Tears
episodes.summary: Satsuki unveils a plan to rebuild Honnōji Academy using a brutal survival challenge. Ryuko and Mako's joyride ends in unexpected peril.

episodes.title: A Once in a Lifetime Chance
episodes.summary: It's the final round of the Naturals Election, and the Elite Four are all eager to face Ryuko. Her teacher worries if she'll survive.

episodes.title: I Want to Know More About You
episodes.summary: Ryuko enters her first Elite Four battle, where an opponent predicts her every move using collected battle data.

episodes.title: I'm Not Your Cute Woman
episodes.summary: Ryuko's fight with the Elite Four takes to the skies, while a mysterious girl's presence in town raises questions.

episodes.title: Spit Your Sadness Away
episodes.summary: Ryuko confronts her father's killer, but risks losing control. Can she be stopped before it's too late?

episodes.title: Feeling Like Scattered Roses... When You Are Near
episodes.summary: Honnōji Academy gears up for the Tri-City Schools Raid Trip. Ryuko's recent trauma leaves her unwilling to fight - until Shinjiro Nagita steps in.

episodes.title: Ride Like the Wind
episodes.summary: The raid begins! Unusual defenses and the loss of Senketsu complicate Ryuko's role in the attack.

episodes.title: Don't Stop Me Now
episodes.summary: Satsuki leads the Osaka defense against a powerful industrial opponent, sensing a deeper threat at play.

episodes.title: The Girl Can't Help It
episodes.summary: The raid returns to Honnōji, but Satsuki is unexpectedly summoned home. Ryuko starts uncovering truths about her bond with Senketsu.

episodes.title: Tell Me Why
episodes.summary: Preparations are underway for the Academy's Cultural & Sports Festival, but Ragyo's attendance hints at hidden motives.

episodes.title: Into the Night
episodes.summary: The festival erupts into chaos. Ryuko must decide who she can trust, even as Life Fiber power grows.

episodes.title: Raindrops Keep Falling on My Head
episodes.summary: A shocking revelation shakes Ryuko's world. Friends, foes, and Nudist Beach struggle to regroup.

episodes.title: Far from the Madding Crowd
episodes.summary: Ryuko, determined to kill Ragyo and Nui, heads out alone. Without her power, Nudist Beach faces tough choices.

episodes.title: Incomplete
episodes.summary: Ryuko's rampage continues with unexpected new allies. Can the Elite Four and Nudist Beach withstand the onslaught?

episodes.title: Tell Me How You Feel
episodes.summary: Ryuko reunites with Senketsu and faces Nui Harime, recovering both Scissor Blades. Satsuki and Ryuko reconcile and prepare for Ragyō's plan to destroy humanity.

episodes.title: Imitation Gold
episodes.summary: Ryuko and Satsuki confront Ragyō at the Original Life Fiber, sending the massive entity crashing down with Mako's determined help, even as Nui prepares a terrifying new Kamui.

episodes.title: Past the Infinite Darkness
episodes.summary: In the final confrontation, Ragyō harnesses overwhelming power to absorb all Life Fibers. Ryuko and allies struggle to stop the apocalyptic threat and protect humanity.
